edge_case: ~15% p.a. illustration read as a guaranteed return
what_the_ui_does: Copy uses assumed / historical blended language plus T&C. Not framed as a promise.

edge_case: 9.99% p.a. credit rate read as a locked offer
what_the_ui_does: Borrow footer marks it as T&C. Rate is disclosed copy only.

edge_case: User thinks a draw sells mutual fund units
what_the_ui_does: Copy says lien / units stay invested. UI never says withdraw from MF.
Borrow shows progress to unlock. Draw controls are hidden. No fake credit line.

edge_case: Draw larger than 50% of invested minus amount already out
what_the_ui_does: Reducer clamps the draw to remaining LTV. Credit left cannot go negative.
Drawn amount clears to zero. Invested units are unchanged (never sold in mock state).

edge_case: Daily SIP typed or stepped below ₹21 or above ₹50 000
what_the_ui_does: Amount is clamped to ₹21–₹50 000 in the store and on Save steppers / pills.

edge_case: Home calculator mistaken for a live order
what_the_ui_does: Projection is local only. It does not mutate invested / wallet.

edge_case: ₹10L target read as a BlinkMoney goal product
what_the_ui_does: Labelled as an illustrative target in calc comments and UI. Not a goal-date product.

edge_case: Correction / Severe read as a forever negative CAGR
what_the_ui_does: Shock is 1–2 years then recovery rates. Not a permanent -4% path.

edge_case: Raise SIP or step-up on Stress Test
what_the_ui_does: Updates the simulation only. Does not place an order or change the live daily SIP.
failSip sets pending to failed and drops Momentum. Retry restores active + Momentum. No live bank.
Empty state with a path to Save. Chart and scores are not shown.

edge_case: Streak under 3 days or invested under ₹500
what_the_ui_does: Insufficient-data state. Current seed (₹18 400 / 14-day streak) skips this on first paint.
Short skeleton then the live mock.

edge_case: User cancels the OS share sheet
what_the_ui_does: Share promise is caught. App does not crash.
Share text is streak + score only. Wealth Circle compares habits not balances.
Trimmed empty name falls back to a placeholder name so the pair still renders.
Invite CTA and privacy copy. No fake peer list.
Progress uses pixel width not %.
Ring charts set originX / originY.
Haptics calls are swallowed.
Share includes a title for the Android sheet.

edge_case: Tab indicator flicker with elevation on a translating view
what_the_ui_does: Indicator is transform-only.
softwareKeyboardLayoutMode resize.

Profile is a stack screen so it does not reserve tab-bar padding.

edge_case: Web tab bar clipped by overflow
what_the_ui_does: Web tab bar portals to document.body and is position:fixed.
